source: pup.glb skinned to the KayKit Rig_Medium skeleton (KayKit Character Animations 1.1, CC0, Kay Lousberg) by tools/art/pup_rig.py: bones moved to the pup's proportions (orientations kept), arm chains turned down onto the mesh arms, auto weights + rigid head/ears/face and tail. TEST: only idle + run clips.
note: Loaded before manifest.json (src/render/playerView.ts PLAYER_MANIFESTS). Anims without a clip (jump, fall, slide, land) use the code motion. ?pup=code in the URL forces the unrigged pup.
